notes: Settlement 2026-11-07: muni_interest.treatment: A said other_states_taxed_own_exempt, B said other; PDF p.64 line 1 adds all state and municipal interest 'unless specifically exempt' and exempts only 'certain Iowa state and municipal securities' (a printed list), so other.

Settlement 2026-11-07: personal, age-65, blind and dependent amounts: A said base.deductions (four entries), B said credit reliefs; PDF p.8, PDF p.18 line 12 and the form (Step 3, line 8, subtracted from tax) say credits against tax, so credit reliefs with credit_amount and credit_basis tax; base.deductions is empty.

Settlement 2026-11-07: personal credit count: A said per exemption claimed, B said one return entry with the count in cap_rule; PDF p.8 gives 1 for status 1, 3, 5 and 2 for status 2 and 4. Written as a per-person credit plus an extra head of household credit, so a joint return gets two (one each) and head of household gets two.

Settlement 2026-11-07: age-65 credit date: B said born_on_or_before 1961-01-01, A said age only; PDF p.8 prints an age test ('65 or older on or before January 1, 2026'), not a birth date, so min_age 65 with the words in other_conditions; B's date dropped as derived.

Settlement 2026-11-07: protection-occupation survivor covers: A said public_pension, B said all retirement kinds; PDF p.68 says the 'Pension income must come from a retirement plan provided for under one of the following Iowa Code sections', so public_pension only, and another state's plan is not covered in this branch.

Settlement 2026-11-07: public_pension_other_state in the age 55, disabled and survivor entries: A and B said covers_unclear; PDF p.67 line 7 says 'a governmental or other pension or retirement plan' with no limit by payer (the only Iowa-only limit in line 7 is on the protection-occupation branch, PDF p.68), so covers. No sentence names another state's pension or New York.
Settlement 2026-11-07: health insurance deduction (A only): kept; PDF p.72-73 prints it. Income test at_or_over 100,000 ('less than $100,000' eligible, '$100,000 or more' not).
Settlement 2026-11-07: disability income exclusion (A only): kept, re-cited to the booklet; PDF p.75 prints it; form subtraction because it excludes 'a portion'.
Settlement 2026-11-07: interest on federal securities (neither reader's entry, both in notes): added as a relief; PDF p.64 line 1 column B and the Line 2 column B dividends sentence print it.

Rate: IA 1040 line 5 'Multiply line 4 by 3.8%' (form PDF p.2); 'Iowa now has a flat tax rate of 3.8%' (PDF p.3 and p.12). One rate for every filing status, so one schedule; no married_separate or head_of_household schedule is printed.

Starting point: Iowa taxable income (line 4) = federal taxable income from federal 1040 line 15 (line 2) + net Iowa modifications (line 3, Schedule 1 line 21). If federal taxable income is zero, line 2 is federal AGI less lines 1d and 1e and federal 1040 line 13b, and it can be negative (PDF p.9-10).
Standard deduction: the booklet prints no Iowa standard deduction amount; the federal standard or itemized deduction is already inside line 2. Exemptions are the Step 3 credits, recorded as reliefs.
Social Security: exempt. Schedule 1 line 5 column B subtracts the amount from federal 1040 line 6b (form PDF p.5); 'Iowa does not tax Social Security benefits' (PDF p.67).

Retirement exclusion: no dollar cap and no income test printed in the booklet, the Schedule 1 web page or the guidance page. Roth conversion income is named as qualifying (PDF p.68; guidance page). Roth IRAs are also named on the guidance page.

Federal civilian pensions: line 7 does not name them. PDF p.90 denies CSRS and FERS only the military exemption (line 4). They are read as 'governmental' under line 7, so public_pension in the 55, disabled and survivor entries.

Other states' government pensions: not named in the booklet; read as covered from the words 'governmental or other pension or retirement plan' (see the settlement line). Iowa's only income tax reciprocal agreement is with Illinois and covers wages and salaries only (PDF p.87); it has no pension rule.

Low-income exemption (PDF p.10-11; not held by a field): after adding back the items on PDF p.10, exempt from Iowa tax at 9,000 or less for single (24,000 if 65 or older on 12/31/25), less than 5,000 for a single filer claimed as a dependent; 13,500 or less for joint, head of household and qualifying surviving spouse (32,000 if you or your spouse was 65 or older on 12/31/25); married filing separately 9,000 or less with 13,500 or less combined. The p.5 filing test gives separate filers 24,000 at 65 or older; p.11's exemption text does not.

Alternate tax (PDF p.12-13; not held by a field): every status except single may take the smaller of the 3.8% tax and 4.3% of (the income base less 13,500, or 32,000 if 65 or older). The worksheet line 2 prints '12/31/2024' where other pages print 12/31/25. Not a recapture: it can only lower the tax.
Tax reduction: single taxpayers not claimed as a dependent 'may owe less tax' using the Income Tax Reduction Worksheet (41-146) (PDF p.18); its terms are not in the sources.

Capital gains: the Iowa capital gain deduction (Schedule 1 line 16, PDF p.74) needs form IA 100; its terms are not found in the sources, so no capital_gains entry. Gains are otherwise taxed at the flat rate.

Farm tenancy income exclusion (Schedule 1 line 18, PDF p.74): retired farmers meeting ten-year tests may exclude income from a farm tenancy agreement; form IA 125. Not held as a relief; recorded here only.
Lump-sum tax (PDF p.13): 25% of the federal tax from form 4972 for Iowa residents, but not if the recipient is disabled, 55 or older, or an eligible survivor. Not held by a field.
National Guard or reserve members called to duty: a withdrawal from a qualified retirement account is not subject to Iowa income tax (PDF p.90; entered on Schedule 1 line 4). Recorded here only.
Local surtaxes: school district and county EMS surtaxes (form line 19, a percentage of line 18 from a list) are local and not in surtaxes; percentages are not in the sources.
Recapture: none found in the booklet; empty list. Indexing: the words indexed, inflation and cost-of-living do not appear for any figure here; not_stated.
